hints.title: Partition Sum Optimization
hints.text: The problem reduces to partitioning n into positive integers that sum to n while maximizing their product.

hints.title: Factor of Three Dominance
hints.text: By arithmetic properties, splitting into factors of 3 produces the maximum product compared to other factor sizes.

hints.title: Remainder Case Splitting
hints.text: If remainder modulo 3 is 1, replace one 3 and 1 with two 2s. If remainder is 2, include one factor of 2.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Iterative multiplication takes O(n) steps, overflowing time limit for primeFactors up to 10^9.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Modular binary exponentiation computes 3^k modulo 10^9 + 7 in logarithmic time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate handles edge cases for n <= 3 and modular arithmetic with power 3 correctly.
